_doc: T.M1/T.M2 — the appearance/taste wave manifest (the born-OWNER gate class registry). A wave listed here is a DESIGN/APPEARANCE/INTERACTION disposition: (a) it may not CLOSE without a committed, FILLED owner-verdict artifact under docs/tranches/T/verdicts/<id>.md (proof:owner-verdict-recorded, T.M1); (b) its born-RED design oracle may not be AUTHORED until its OD row carries an owner token (proof:owner-review-gate, T.M2). Each design band appends its appearance waves here AS it authors them (lockstep). The `od` field, when present, names the OWNER-DECISIONS.md row that must carry a token before the wave's `oracle` may exist in package.json; `oracle` (when named) is the born-RED proof:* key the wave authors — proof:owner-review-gate REDs if that key exists in package.json while its `od` row is still PENDING-OWNER.
